channel.title: Wyatt's Notes — Networking
channel.description: Networking reference notes covering protocols, configuration, and administration.

item.title: The Seven Layers of the OSI Model
item.description: Physical, data link, network, transport, session, presentation, and application layers with protocols and device mappings.

item.title: IPv4 Addressing and Subnetting
item.description: IPv4 address classes, CIDR notation, subnet masks, VLSM, and worked subnetting calculations with practical examples.

item.title: IPv6 Addressing
item.description: IPv6 address format, address types (unicast, multicast, anycast), header differences from IPv4, and transition mechanisms.

item.title: TCP Three-Way Handshake and Flow Control
item.description: Connection establishment, sequence and acknowledgement numbers, sliding window, congestion control (slow start, AIMD), and TCP states.

item.title: UDP and Comparison with TCP
item.description: User Datagram Protocol, header format, unreliability, and when to use UDP vs TCP for applications like DNS, VoIP, and streaming.

item.title: DNS Resolution and Record Types
item.description: Hierarchical DNS, recursive vs iterative queries, A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, and NS records, plus TTL and caching behaviour.

item.title: HTTP Methods and Status Codes
item.description: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, status code classes (1xx-5xx), RESTful conventions, and content negotiation with examples.

item.title: TLS Handshake and Certificate Chains
item.description: TLS 1.3 handshake, key exchange, symmetric encryption, certificate authorities, trust chains, and OCSP stapling.

item.title: Wireshark and Packet Analysis
item.description: Capturing traffic, display filters, protocol dissection, following TCP streams, and diagnosing network issues with Wireshark.

item.title: Ethernet and MAC Addresses
item.description: Ethernet frames, MAC address structure, ARP protocol, switching, VLANs, and STP with practical configuration examples.

item.title: Wi-Fi Standards and Security
item.description: 802.11 standards (a/b/g/n/ac/ax), channel allocation, SSID, WPA3, and enterprise wireless network design considerations.

item.title: SMTP, IMAP, and POP3
item.description: Email protocols, message flow, SMTP relay, IMAP folders vs POP3 download, MIME types, and email security (SPF, DKIM, DMARC).

item.title: Network Address Translation and Port Forwarding
item.description: NAT types (static, dynamic, PAT), port forwarding configuration, hairpin NAT, and troubleshooting common NAT issues.

item.title: Networking — Complete Guide
item.description: Networking reference notes covering OSI model, IP addressing, TCP/UDP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, network tools, Layer 2, wireless, and email protocols.
